name: scad-ai-ide
description: OpenSCAD runtime discovery and development tools for VS Code

scad-ai-ide.openscadPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the OpenSCAD executable, or a macOS `.app`. Leave empty for automatic discovery (PATH, then common installation locations). Runs on the extension host, including SSH, WSL, or containers.

scad-ai-ide.runtimeCommand.markdownDescription: Selected runtime launch command, including Flatpak/Snap arguments. Use **SCAD AI IDE: Select OpenSCAD Runtime** to change it. `openscadPath` takes precedence when nonempty.

scad-ai-ide.languageServer.path.description: Absolute path to openscad-lsp on the extension host. Empty uses the bundled binary, then openscad-lsp on PATH.

scad-ai-ide.languageServer.searchPaths.description: Absolute OpenSCAD library directories. Changing this setting restarts the server to remove stale paths.

scad-ai-ide.languageServer.defaultParame.description: Include optional default parameters in LSP completion snippets.

scad-ai-ide.languageServer.indent.description: Whitespace used by the OpenSCAD formatter.

scad-ai-ide.languageServer.queryFile.description: Absolute path to a custom Topiary formatting query. Empty uses the server default.

scad-ai-ide.preview.format.description: The format to use for the 3D preview. 3MF supports colors but requires OpenSCAD Nightly. STL is universally supported.

enumDescriptions: Image-based Boolean preview using the independent Preview Exporter and Goldfeather depth/stencil rendering (macOS ARM64).
Standard interactive mesh preview using the selected OpenSCAD CLI.
scad-ai-ide.preview.renderMode.description: Fast image-based preview or Full Render. Both support camera navigation.

scad-ai-ide.preview.slicerExecutable.description: Optional path to the slicer executable (e.g., Bambu Studio or PrusaSlicer). If left empty, the OS default application for the 3D model will be used.

scad-ai-ide.preview.enableLazyUnion.description: Enable lazy unions, creating a multi-part exported object.

scad-ai-ide.markdown.preview.enabled.description: Show Preview and Source tabs for OpenSCAD fenced blocks in built-in and extension-managed Markdown previews. Requires workspace trust and an available OpenSCAD runtime.

enumDescriptions: Image-based Boolean preview using the independent Preview Exporter and Goldfeather depth/stencil rendering (macOS ARM64).
Standard interactive mesh preview using the selected OpenSCAD CLI.
scad-ai-ide.markdown.preview.renderMode.description: Fast image-based preview or Full Render. Both support camera navigation.

scad-ai-ide.preview.exporterPath.description: Independent bin/openscad-preview-exporter wrapper (macOS ARM64, openscad-2026.11-RC0, Schema v1). Empty discovers the managed installation and PATH. Full Render uses the separately selected OpenSCAD CLI.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_capabilities_discover
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Discover live availability, constraints and tool names for Runtime, Libraries, Customizer and diagnostics. No changes; returns bounded capability metadata.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_operation_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Poll a specific operation ID or list recent operations. Returns running/terminal state and progress message, no changes.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_operation_cancel
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Request cancellation of a running operation using its exact ID. Returns its current state; non-cancellable critical sections finish before terminal status.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_runtime_state
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read actual active/installed runtimes, host paths, discovery state, revision and errors without opening a panel. Use before selection or removal.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_runtime_builds
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Load available release builds for the extension host. Optional refresh/channel; bounded exact build IDs, versions and cache/error status. Network read only.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_runtime_refresh
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Discover runtimes on the extension host and return actual post-refresh state. Requires workspace trust; does not install.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_runtime_installBuild
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Install an exact numeric build ID returned by runtime_builds. Downloads to managed storage; supports cancellation and returns verified discovery state. Requires trust.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_runtime_installArchive
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Install a host-local archive at an absolute path. Validates archive safety and probes runtime; managed storage only, trust required. Supports cancellation.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_runtime_addExecutable
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Probe and select a host-local executable or macOS app at an absolute path. Changes global runtime selection after validation; trust required.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_runtime_select
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Select the exact runtime ID from runtime_state. Changes global runtime configuration; returns actual active runtime and updates Preview. Trust and current identity required.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_runtime_remove
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Remove an exact managed runtime ID from runtime_state. Independent user confirmation required; unmanaged paths rejected. Revalidates managed identity and returns discovered state.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_state
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read active model target URI, revision, complete parameter types/ranges/default/current values and preset status. Overrides do not edit SCAD source; no panel required.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_set
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Set validated parameter overrides atomically on the exact target/revision from customizer_state. Values must match parameter schema. Updates GUI/Preview; does not edit SCAD source.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_reset
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reset one named parameter or all overrides for exact target/revision. Returns actual values; updates Preview without editing source.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_applyPreset
languageModelTools.modelDescription: applyPreset for exact target URI and revision from customizer_state. Named presets use existing OpenSCAD JSON format; explicit file URIs must be inside the host workspace. Returns verified parameter/preset state; preserves other presets and metadata. Empty name applies design defaults. Overrides do not edit source.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_createPreset
languageModelTools.modelDescription: createPreset for exact target URI and revision from customizer_state. Named presets use existing OpenSCAD JSON format; explicit file URIs must be inside the host workspace. Returns verified parameter/preset state; preserves other presets and metadata.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_savePreset
languageModelTools.modelDescription: savePreset for exact target URI and revision from customizer_state. Named presets use existing OpenSCAD JSON format; explicit file URIs must be inside the host workspace. Returns verified parameter/preset state; preserves other presets and metadata.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_deletePreset
languageModelTools.modelDescription: deletePreset for exact target URI and revision from customizer_state. Named presets use existing OpenSCAD JSON format; explicit file URIs must be inside the host workspace. Returns verified parameter/preset state; preserves other presets and metadata. Requires independent user confirmation.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_importPresets
languageModelTools.modelDescription: importPresets for exact target URI and revision from customizer_state. Named presets use existing OpenSCAD JSON format; explicit file URIs must be inside the host workspace. Returns verified parameter/preset state; preserves other presets and metadata.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_exportPresets
languageModelTools.modelDescription: exportPresets for exact target URI and revision from customizer_state. Named presets use existing OpenSCAD JSON format; explicit file URIs must be inside the host workspace. Returns verified parameter/preset state; preserves other presets and metadata.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_search
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search real registry metadata for IDs, exact versions and supported layouts. Bounded query, pagination and optional detail ID. Returns freshness/errors; no install.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_refresh
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Refresh registry independent of panels. Network read, returns actual catalog status/errors; cached data is identified.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_projectState
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List workspace projects, or dependencies for one exact project path returned by this tool. Reports manifest/lock and mount state; no writes.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_globalState
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inspect bounded global cache metadata, integrity issues and references. Exact cache keys identify verify/repair/cleanup targets. No raw file inventories.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_install
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Install exact version label returned by libraries_search; writes project manifest/lock and mounts using shared atomic transactions. Explicit workspace project path required; trust and path safety enforced. Cancellable; returns verified dependency state.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_remove
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Remove project dependency; preserves global cached sources. Explicit workspace project path required; trust and path safety enforced. Cancellable; returns verified dependency state.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_restore
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Restore dependencies using authoritative lockfile commits; never silently re-resolve tags. Explicit workspace project path required; trust and path safety enforced. Cancellable; returns verified dependency state.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_verify
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Verify one exact cache key or all cached versions. Checks local inventory corruption, not independent supply-chain authenticity. Returns actual failures, trust required.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_repair
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Repair an exact cache key from globalState. Rechecks repository/commit identity; requires trust, supports cancellation and preserves source safety checks.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_cleanupPlan
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read-only preflight of single cache key or mode unused/all. Returns expiring server plan ID, candidates, bytes, protections and impact; does not delete. Requires trust.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_libraries_cleanupExecute
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Execute an unexpired exact plan ID from cleanupPlan. Independently asks the human to authorize exact targets; JSON cannot approve deletion. Rechecks state/references under store locks. Returns actual removals.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_more_githubStatus
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Refresh silently and read GitHub mode/account label/rate-limit hint only. Never returns tokens or session objects.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_more_authorizeGitHub
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Start real interactive VS Code GitHub authentication. User must complete Accounts flow. Returns safe status only; no access token is exposed. Anonymous access remains available.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_development_status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read whether extension runs in Development mode. Safe in production; reports reason when cache tools are disabled.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_development_listCaches
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Development mode only. Returns bounded cache IDs/names/scopes without values. Installed runtimes, exporter and library sources/reference indices are excluded.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_development_inspectCache
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Development mode only. Inspect one exact cache ID from listCaches. Returns bounded redacted preview, which may still contain personal information. No arbitrary file reads.

languageModelTools.name: scad_ai_ide_development_clearCaches
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Development mode only. Choose exactly one cache ID, scope or all=true. Independent user confirmation required; clears only disposable caches, reports partial failures and invalidates owners.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run build:lsp && npm run package
scripts.compile: npm run check:agents && npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check:agents && npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production && npm run prepare:licenses
scripts.test: npm run compile-tests && node --test out/test/capabilities.test.js out/test/capabilityServices.test.js out/test/notifications.test.js out/test/runtime.test.js out/test/github.test.js out/test/installation.test.js out/test/customizer.test.js out/test/language.test.js out/test/markdown.test.js && npm run test:libraries && npm run test:preview
scripts.test:customizer: npm run compile-tests && node esbuild.js && node --test scripts/customizer-scrollbar.test.mjs
scripts.test:markdown: npm run compile && npm run compile-tests && node --test out/test/markdown.test.js && node --test scripts/markdown-preview.test.mjs
scripts.test:fast-preview: npm run compile && node --import tsx --test src/test/preview/preparedScene.test.ts src/test/preview/fastPreview.test.ts && node --test scripts/preview-fast.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && vscode-test
scripts.test:libraries:integration: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && vscode-test --grep "Library Manager extension host"
scripts.test:capabilities: npm run compile-tests && node --test out/test/capabilities.test.js out/test/capabilityServices.test.js

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Runtime discovery and execution require workspace trust.
